name: Rod of Security

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Paradise
powers.text: Magic action: you and your companions go to a demiplane paradise to rest in perfect safety, returning where you left (once every 10 days).

summary: Takes the party to a safe paradise demiplane to rest and recover, then brings everyone back.
text: Activate the rod with a Magic action to whisk you and as many as 199 other willing creatures in sight into an extraplanar paradise whose form you decide. Whatever it looks like, it always has enough food and water for everyone there, and anything else you can interact with inside it can't exist anywhere else. Each hour spent there restores a visitor's Hit Points as though spending 1 Hit Point Die. Creatures don't age inside, though time keeps passing normally. The total stay can't exceed 200 days divided by how many creatures are present. When that time is up, or when you end it with a Magic action, everyone returns to the spot they occupied when the rod was activated, or to the closest unoccupied space. The rod then can't be used again for ten days.
